claim_boundary: mapped area/cell cost of the probe only; no place-and-route, no timing closure, no fit claim, no audibility claim; RTL-vs-model agreement is tools/h01_compare.py's result

cycles_per_operator.budget_input: the kernel's 1 clk/eval leaves 1.67 clk/eval (96 of 256 used) at 12.288 MHz and 4.33 clk/eval (96 of 512) at 24.576 MHz for state access, control and output -- the N01 section-7 all-in question; whether the shared core with H02 storage sustains <= 2.67 stays unproven here (that schedule is H03/H10)
cycles_per_operator.note: one evaluation accepted per clock once the 3-stage pipeline is full (measured by the equivalence harness: every eval stream sustains 1 eval/clk)

schedule_context.design_point: 24.576 MHz; 12.288 MHz fallback only if the shared operator core measures <= 2 clk/eval

declared_vs_mapped_state.note: mapped < declared is expected and behavior-preserving: yosys exploits ROM-content constants (e.g. sinlog entries never set bit 15) and sign-extension redundancy of out_q/clip_q, replacing redundant flops with wires. The contract the mapping must preserve is RTL behavior, proven bit-exact to the frozen model by tools/h01_compare.py.

full.requirement: mapped flops > 32 (irreducible 32-bit phase accumulator) and chip area > 0 and sequential area > 0 and cells > 0

strip_negative_control.requirement: strip-observability must make the flop gate FAIL (all state removed)

pipeline_structure.content: phi fold (mirror XOR + quadrant sign) + sinlog ROM read + env capture
log-domain level add (mod 2^16) + sign split + sinexp ROM read + shift capture
registered XOR reduction of all state bits

rom_representation.detail: both 1024x16 ROMs dissolve to combinational gates (yosys MEMORY_MAP; no BRAM in this flow); final stat shows no memory cells

tool_identity.constraints: no SDC: probe flow per issue #20 (read_verilog; synth -top; dfflibmap; abc; ltp; stat), no clock defined
tool_identity.dont_use_policy: none: *_1 drive cells allowed (declared per D01 section 4/section 10.3)
